sentences.en: Salvadoran pirated disc vendor holds a copy of "The Chronicles of Narnia" during a protest against the CAFTA (Central American Free Trade Act) in San Salvador January 9, 2006.

sentences.en: Salvadoran foreign ministry said unidentified gunmen stopped a cargo train in the state of Oaxaca in the south of Mexico on Thursday.

sentences.en: Dare Chicest, 21, the daughter of Salvadoran immigrants, is a graduating senior at Occidental, where she has taken Professor Dreier's course and worked with teenage girls.
